q: 1. Labour Labour act was introduced/founded in
explain: The Labour Act in Nepal was enacted in 2048 BS to make provisions relating to labor standards, rights, safety, and relations.

q: 2. Who is the chairperson of Central Labour Advisory Board?
explain: As per the Labour Act provisions, the Minister or State Minister for Labour chairs the Central Labour Advisory Board.

q: 3. Workers are not allowed to work contiunously more than
explain: Labor regulations mandate that no worker shall be deployed continuously for more than 5 hours without a minimum rest/lunch interval.

q: 4. Workers aren't allowed to work continuously more than ........
explain: Under the Labor Act, a worker should not work continuously for more than 5 hours without a rest interval.

q: 5. The employer's have right to
explain: Under procurement law, the employer (as procuring entity) retains the right to either accept or reject any or all bids, subject to prescribed conditions.

q: 6. For the supply of any goods as per agreement, who is responsible for the all taxed imposed by the GoN
explain: Under standard supply agreements, the supplier bears responsibility for all taxes imposed by the Government of Nepal on the supplied goods.

q: 7. The project maintenance remains as a contractual obligation of the project contractor until the expiry of ........
explain: The contractor must repair defects until the defect liability period ends.

q: 8. In selecting consultant for procurement goods and service, which of following method adopted?
explain: Consultant selection methods under procurement guidelines include Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS), Fixed Budget Selection, and Least Cost Selection, applied depending on the nature of the assignment.

q: 9. The type of contract when payment shall be made for actual work done at site is
explain: In a Unit Rate (item rate) contract, payment is based on actual measured quantities of work executed at site, multiplied by agreed unit rates.

q: 10. The employer has to take responsibility for the wrong of his employees even though he has not committed that mistake is
explain: This is the legal principle of vicarious liability, where an employer is held responsible for the wrongful acts of employees committed in the course of their employment.

q: 11. Engineers shall not disclose, without ........ confidential information coming the business affairs of technical process of any present or former or employer, or public body on which they serve.
explain: The Code of Ethics requires engineers not to disclose confidential business or technical information without the consent of the employer or client.

q: 12. Contractor is liable to maintain the defects up to ........
explain: The contractor's liability to fix defects ends when the defect liability period ends.

q: 13. The dispute resolution method in any contract is ........
explain: Contracts provide a ladder of methods: amicable settlement, adjudication board and arbitration.

q: 14. What percent of interest is taken for the advance amount paid to the contractor by employer?
explain: Mobilization advance payment extended to a contractor is interest-free against an unconditional bank guarantee; hence 0% interest applies.

q: 15. According to labor act, maximum working hour for a labor per week should be ........
explain: The Labor Act limits regular work to 8 hours a day and 48 hours a week.

q: 16. The employer's have right to
explain: The employer retains full statutory rights to accept or reject any bid during the procurement process prior to contract award.

q: 17. Bidding documents of any civil work contract consists of
explain: As per the answer key, the correct component listed among the given bidding document elements is the Preamble of BOQ.

q: 18. To work for survey, design estimate & supervision of a road project, the consultant has to submit
explain: Consulting procurement (QCBS/QBS) requires dual submission of separate Technical and Financial proposals.

q: 19. Which is not concerned with the authority of engineers?
options: express and opinion of engineering matter
explain: Divulging confidential matters is a professional prohibition, not an authority granted to engineers.

q: 20. The method of selection of consultant for common engineering services in Nepal is mostly:
explain: Consultants for common engineering services in Nepal are typically selected using the Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) method.

q: 21. Adjudicator of the contract means:
options: a person designated in the contract for dispute resolution
a person who in named as one man arbitrator
a person who is a representative of regulation agency
explain: An adjudicator is the person specifically designated within the contract for resolving disputes between the parties.

q: 22. Engineer shall not disclose, without...............confidential information concerning the business affairs or technical processes of any present or former client or employer or public body on which the serve:
explain: Engineers are ethically forbidden from revealing proprietary/confidential business details without explicit prior consent.

q: 23. Consultant mediates between ........
explain: The consultant acts as an intermediary between the client (employer) and the contractor.

q: 24. An engineer designs a small structural steel building for a client, using pirated structural design software obtained from the Internet. The engineer later learns that the software gives accurate stress analysis for tension, but does not properly predict buckling of columns in compression. The revised analysis shows the building is not as safe as first believed and could collapse in an extreme (1-in-10-year) snowfall. What should the engineer do?
options: Contact the client, disclose the problem, and try to negotiate a way to reinforce the columns.
Destroy all evidence of the revised analysis and hope for good weather
Contact the client, disclose the problem and tell the client to sue the software developer
Hire a good defence lawyer for the Association's disciplinary hearing against the engineer for negligence and unprofessional conduct
explain: Professional ethics requires engineers to hold public safety paramount; upon discovering a safety defect, the engineer must promptly disclose it to the client and take corrective action, such as negotiating reinforcement of the columns.

q: 25. All of the followings are contract types except ........
explain: Unit price, cost reimbursement and lump sum are contract types. 'Make or buy' is a procurement decision, not a contract type.

q: 26. In Nepal, which of the following Act contains the provisions o health and safety of the workers ?
explain: The Labour Act specifically sets forth binding statutory norms for worker safety, workplace sanitation, and health protections.

q: 27. Quality assurance is achieved by ........
explain: The answer key gives 'engineer'. Quality assurance involves several parties, so this key looks debatable.

q: 28. Federation of contractor's association of Nepal is established in ........
explain: As per the answer key, FCAN was established in 1997 AD.

q: 29. Security deposits deducted from the contractor's bill is ........
options: refunded when defect liability period is over
refunded upon the completion of work
refunded when good progress is achieved
retained until the life span of project
explain: Retention money guards against defects, so it is released after the defect liability period ends.
